tool_args.rationale: Five observations at a single long horizon cannot distinguish plausible relaxation laws or reliably identify their parameters. The slow-horizon probe targets that ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary smooth model to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations share one horizon, leaving the slow-horizon dependence and competing transient mechanisms unidentified.
The observed slow-horizon and damped-transient signatures make horizon discrimination more directly relevant.
Fine transient resolution is less directly relevant to the long-horizon forecast than a discriminating slow-horizon probe.
It is irrelevant to identifying the target law.
